SELECT DISTINCT r.id,r.name,r.normalized_name,r.path,r.source_type,r.default_branch,r.current_commit, r.worktree_digest,r.worktree_dirty,r.current_snapshot_id,r.current_snapshot_path,r.codegraph_path, r.snapshot_created_at,r.last_scanned_at,r.owner_account_id,r.ownership_version,r.repository_status, r.created_at,r.updated_at,r.description,r.repository_version FROM repositories r LEFT JOIN repository_permissions p ON p.repo_id=r.id AND p.account_id=#{accountId} LEFT JOIN accounts owner_account ON owner_account.id=r.owner_account_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{admin}=TRUE OR r.owner_account_id=#{accountId} OR p.account_id IS NOT NULL)
AND (LOWER(r.name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{query}),'%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.description,'')) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{query}),'%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.default_branch,'')) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{query}),'%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(owner_account.username,'')) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{query}),'%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(owner_account.display_name,'')) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{query}),'%'))
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repositories WHERE owner_account_id=#{ownerId} AND normalized_name=#{normalizedName} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repositories WHERE path=#{path} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repositories WHERE owner_account_id=#{ownerId} AND normalized_name=#{normalizedName} AND id<>#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
